title: Finite dimensionality from normalized local lattices
statement: For any recorded lattice [def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data], its integral fibre at any algebraically closed geometric point is a finite free A-module and its rationalized fibre is finite dimensional over E. If LocalLattices exists for a rational realization, all its intrinsic heart fibres are finite dimensional.

proof.text: Apply normalized tower finite freeness to the actual stalk tower. Its finiteFree and lisse fields give exactly the freeness, surjectivity and kernel hypotheses. Tensor extension preserves finite generation. Choose a local lattice chart through a specified point and transfer finite dimensionality across its normalization isomorphism.

theorem lattice_fiber_finite_free {T : Scheme.{u}} (N : Lattice l E T)
    (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [IsAlgClosed κ] (x : Spec (.of κ) ⟶ T) :
    Module.Finite (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (N.fiber l E κ x) ∧
      Module.Free (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (N.fiber l E κ x)
